units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:6">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>מי ש׳ של ביצים</he> water in which eggs have been boiled; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:2:5">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:8">Ber. VI, 8</cite> <he>אפי׳ אכל ש׳ וכ׳</he> even if one eats overboiled vegetable, and he makes a meal of it.

<cite ref="Berakhot 44b:9">Ib. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ומי איכא מידי דהוי ש׳ מזונו</he> (not <he>מזוני</he>) is there a thing which a person makes a meal of when it is boiled to a pulp?; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁלָקִין</he>, <cite ref="U01385"><he>שְׁלָקוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:13">Tosef. Ter. VII, 13</cite>; Y, <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 8">ib. VIII</cite>, 45ᵈ.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite> <he>ש׳ וכבשין</he> things preserved by boiling or by pressing (by gentiles); a. e.
